policy.heatspawn: HotSpawn supplies fixtures and crowd ownership only. Its 'picked %' is never a probability input.
policy.rejected_placeholder: egamersworld prints exactly 1.80 / 1.80 with 0% / 0% on matches no book has priced. It is a placeholder, not a market. Never used as a line.
policy.devig: fair p_A = (1/d_A) / ((1/d_A)+(1/d_B)); exchange cents normalised the same way; multiple accepted two-sided sources averaged with equal weight.
policy.model: p_A = 1 / (1 + 10^(-(Pts_A - Pts_B) * k / 400)) using official Valve VRS points from standings_global_2026_10_05.md and the board's fitted k = 0.421341 (11 market/model pairs, MAE 0.075). The 400-point scale is this project's modelling assumption, not a Valve quantity.
policy.pick_only: Where no two-sided price exists and the opponent has no official rating, a direction is published with NO percentage, flagged low-confidence. A blank percentage is deliberate.

twc.event_facts: Oct 14-18 2026, Malta, 8 teams, $1,000,000 ($500k player / $500k club). Single-elimination playoffs; semifinals Oct 17; grand final Oct 18.

upset.why_it_happened: 9z won their own pick, Inferno, 13-11, then took Nuke 13-1. Both maps are verified. This was a veto-and-map collapse, not a slow series loss - there is no third map and no close scoreline to blame on variance.
upset.correction: Aurora fixed it inside 48 hours: 2-0 over Ninjas in Pyjamas, then 2-0 over 9z in the Day-3 decider with Cache 13-11 and Inferno 13-4. The team that lost on Day 1 had changed its veto by Day 3.
upset.lesson: Treat the Day-1 upset as evidence about the Nuke veto, not about Aurora's form. On Day 4 Aurora are the 48.6% side against a FURIA team that has not lost a series all week.

roster.verdict: No October 2026 Aurora change exists. The last rebuild was July 2026.
roster.detail: In July 2026 Aurora added kyxsan from Falcons, completing a rebuild that also brought in Jimpphat and coach ash and replaced MAJ3R, soulfly and Fabre. The official VRS snapshot of 5 Oct still lists exactly that five: Jimpphat, kyxsan, Wicadia, woxic, XANTARES.
roster.implication: Do not discount Aurora for 'new roster' reasons: any onboarding tax was paid in July and August. The Day-1 loss is better explained by 9z taking their own pick on Inferno and then a 13-1 Nuke.

sf1.hltv_read: VERIFIED with arithmetic: HLTV's page renders '10:00' with a 4h17m countdown at 09:49Z, and the HotSpawn lobby renders 'Oct 17, 10:00' with 'Locks in 04:09:47' at 09:50Z. Both therefore resolve to a 14:00Z start and a 13:54Z lock. The '10:00' on both sites is a display clock at UTC-4 in this fetch environment, not UTC. The canonical board's 14:00Z stamp is correct and should be trusted over any time read off a rendered page.
context: FURIA won Group B unbeaten (2-0 BETBOOM, 2-1 Legacy) and had 16 Oct off.
Aurora lost the opener, then beat NIP 2-0 and 9z 2-0; they played the Day-3 decider while FURIA rested.
Valve VRS, 5 Oct snapshot: FURIA #7 on 1829 points, Aurora #9 on 1716 - a 113-point edge to FURIA.
stavka's preview reports the 2026 head-to-head at 3-2 Aurora, with Aurora taking last week's meeting 2-1 after losing their own pick 8-13.
sf1.safe_pick: FURIA 51.4% - the market favourite, but only by 2.8 points.
sf1.climb_pick: Aurora at 48.6% against 18% crowd ownership. Fading FURIA costs only 2.8 points of win probability, and an Aurora win passes the 82% of the field who took FURIA. That is the one place on this slate where differentiation is close to free: you are not betting on a bad team, you are betting on a coin flip that almost nobody else took.
sf1.clock_policy: Never convert a displayed match time into UTC by assumption. Either use the board's start_utc, or do countdown arithmetic: start = read_time_utc + remaining_countdown.

context: Falcons won Group A (2-0 NIP, 2-1 9z) and had 16 Oct off.
BETBOOM lost 0-2 to FURIA, then beat PARIVISION 2-1 and Legacy 2-1: three series in three days.
Valve VRS, 5 Oct snapshot: Falcons #6 on 1843 points, BETBOOM #11 on 1596.
stavka reports Falcons dropped a map in 63.5% of matches over the last three months, and in 4 of their last 5 series.
sf2.climb_pick: None on the series winner. BETBOOM at 25.3% is far below the 40% floor: fading here gives up about 49 points of win probability, and no plausible ownership edge repays that. If you want the contrarian angle, it is the map market (BETBOOM +1.5 / over 2.5 maps), not the series result.
sf2.hltv_read: Board 17:00Z. HLTV and the lobby render this as 13:00, i.e. the same UTC-4 display clock. Kickoff 17:00Z.

day_by_day.label: Day 2 (15 Oct) told us the favourites were beatable on maps
day_by_day.detail: FURIA dropped their only map of the week in a 2-1 over Legacy. Falcons needed three maps to beat 9z. BETBOOM needed three to beat PARIVISION. No team won 2-0 on Day 2.

day_by_day.label: Day 3 (16 Oct) settled both groups without a sweep
day_by_day.detail: Aurora beat 9z 2-0 (Cache 13-11, Inferno 13-4), avenging the Day-1 loss. BETBOOM beat Legacy 2-1, coming from 4-10 down to win Nuke 16-13 before closing it 13-11 on Mirage.

day_by_day.label: What it changes for Day 4
day_by_day.detail: FURIA are the only semifinalist that has not lost a series, and the only one that rested on 16 Oct. BETBOOM have played three series in three days and won two of them the hard way, which points at map-length markets rather than the series price.

day_by_day.label: What it does not change
day_by_day.detail: Aurora's Day-1 defeat was a Nuke veto problem that they had already fixed by Day 3. It is not evidence that the roster is unsettled: the last change was July 2026.

2. Two-sided line from a secondary book or exchange (stavka-quoted books, kushvsporte, vprognoze, egamersworld bookmaker average, Polymarket).
3. HLTV betting-analytics page - checked for every unpriced fixture; HLTV lists no book price for any of the four unpriced matches this week.
4. Originated model from the official Valve VRS pair (both rosters uniquely identified, standings <= 14 days old).
5. Direction-only pick with a blank percentage, flagged low-confidence, when one side has no official rating.
6. Nothing else. A 1.80/1.80 placeholder is rejected rather than republished.

clock_finding.finding: HLTV and the HotSpawn lobby both render match times on a UTC-4 display clock in this environment.
clock_finding.proof: FURIA-Aurora: page shows 10:00; countdown 4h17m11s at 09:49:38Z => 14:07Z; lobby shows 'Locks in 04:09:47' at 09:49:38Z => 13:59:25Z lock+6min. Canonical board says 14:00Z. Same shift reproduces on VOID (20 Oct 03:00Z board shows as 23:00 on 19th) and CCT EU #11 (11:00Z shows as 07:00).
clock_finding.rule: Board start_utc is authoritative. Displayed times are never read as UTC.
clock_finding.consequence: An earlier draft of this session flagged the board as 4 hours late. That was wrong and has been retracted; nothing based on it was published.
